title: Applied Compassion
tagline: Train the skill of caring well — for others and yourself
curricula: Stanford CCT, Rosenberg's Nonviolent Communication, Neff's self-compassion research
endpoint: from good intentions to a daily caring practice that holds under stress
about: Compassion is a trainable skill, not a temperament — the practiced ability to notice suffering, in others and yourself, and respond well. This category treats caring as something you do: presence, listening, empathy, self-compassion, honest boundaries, and de-escalation, practiced deliberately until they hold up under stress.
